selector.candidate_rule: fixed20% grid plus predicted-box center/corner anchored windows
selector.objective: greedy NEW full-containment confidence mass; secondary new object count, then lexicographic coordinates
selector.zero_gain: stop; actual ROI count can be less than K; no duplicated/filler windows
selector.source: S0 final max500 predictions only, no validation GT for S1/S2

fusion: Each global branch is finalized exactly as S0 (max500) before ROI selection AND fusion. ROI intermediate max10000; final class-aware NMS.7/global max500. No boxes/score corrections.

postprocess.edge_suppression: disabled; geometry-only hook for future studies; edge candidates counted at 2px

timing: Sequential image end-to-end, synchronized GPU, includes disk decode, resize/ROI crop, forward, both NMS stages, mapping and CPU transfer. Excludes model load/initial 30 warmups, JSON serialization, scoring. Oracle selection geometry INCLUDED and separately timed. No reused/cached-forward cost masquerading as measured latency.

environment.python: 3.11.17 | packaged by Anaconda, Inc. | (main, Oct  1 2026, 20:16:54) [MSC v.1942 64 bit (AMD64)]

warmup: 30 square640 on model load, then 3 repeats per unique tensor shape before each scheme, excluded
